reasons: CS4226 is only offered in Sem 1 (odd semesters). The available odd semesters from the current one (Sem 6) are Sem 7. Sem 7 is designated for ATAP (CP3880), which allows a maximum of 8 MC for other courses. The remaining required modules CS3219 (4 MC) and CS3210 (4 MC, prerequisite for CS4231) must be completed before CS4231 can be taken. Placing CS3219 and CS3210 in Sem 7 results in 8 MC, leaving no room for CS4226 (4 MC). Placing them in Sem 8 is not possible for CS3210 as it is a prerequisite for CS4231 (which would also be in Sem 8, requiring CS3210 to be completed or corequisite, but CS3210 is not a corequisite). Thus, CS4226 cannot be scheduled without violating ATAP MC limits or prerequisite constraints.
